facts.heading: WHERE IT BEGAN
facts.body: China led in 1873 with 359.2 million people of population - 26.6% of everything recorded that year.

facts.heading: THE RECORDED TOTAL
facts.body: Across the period the combined total went from 1.35 billion to 8.06 billion people - about 6.0x.

facts.heading: BIGGEST SINGLE-YEAR JUMP
facts.body: The largest one-year rise in the pool is China in 1970, up 21.2 million people.

facts.heading: INDIA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: India overtook China in 2022 at 1.43 billion people.

facts.heading: FASTEST RISER
facts.body: Philippines multiplied its population by 23x over the period, reaching 114.9 million people.

facts.heading: WHERE IT STANDS
facts.body: India tops the 2023 table at 1.44 billion people, 17.8% of the recorded total.
